# Empowered Performance

> > Stephanie Thompson's coaching practice specializing in curling-specific fitness training, yoga for athletes, and personalized performance coaching.

Empowered Performance offers evidence-based training programs combining sport-specific conditioning, movement assessment, and rehabilitation services tailored for curlers and competitive athletes. Led by Stephanie Thompson, the practice integrates fitness coaching with specialized yoga programming designed to enhance athletic performance.
